title: 60-Second Biblical Reset for Overthinking
hook: Mind won't shut off? Do this 60-second reset.
script: Mind won't shut off? Do this 60-second reset. Step 1: Be still. Whisper, 'Be still and know that I am God' (Psalm 46:10). Inhale 4, hold 7, exhale 8. Step 2: Name and reframe. Say the loudest thought, then ask, 'Is it true, noble, helpful?' (Philippians 4:8). Replace it with God's promise. Step 3: Cast and thank. Pray, 'Jesus, I cast this on You because You care' (1 Peter 5:7). Thank Him specifically for one thing (Philippians 4:6-7). Step 4: Do the next faithful thing. Take one small obedient step (James 1:22). Repeat whenever worry spikes. Save this as your one-minute anchor back to peace.

title: Midnight Spiral Reset: 4 Steps to Peace
hook: If your thoughts are racing at 2 a.m., try this right now.
script: If your thoughts are racing at 2 a.m., try this right now. Be still. Breathe 4-7-8 as you say, 'Be still and know' (Psalm 46:10). Name the fear. Then filter it through Philippians 4:8: Is this true, honorable, pure? Reframe with God's character. Cast it. Pray, 'Father, I throw this on You because You care' (1 Peter 5:7). Thank Him for today's small mercy; peace begins in gratitude (Philippians 4:6-7). Now do the next faithful thing. Drink water, close a tab, text a friend, or simply sleep, trusting God to work (James 1:22). Save this minute. Use it anytime the spiral starts.

title: God's 1-Minute Off Switch for Overthinking
hook: You may be overthinking this. Here's God's 1-minute off switch.
script: You may be overthinking this. Here's God's 1-minute off switch. Step 1: Be still. Slow 4-7-8 breath and remember, God is God, not your fear (Psalm 46:10). Step 2: Name and reframe. Speak the worry, then hold it up to Philippians 4:8 and swap it for what is true. Step 3: Cast and thank. Hand it to Jesus and thank Him out loud for one concrete grace today (1 Peter 5:7; Philippians 4:6-7). Step 4: Do the next faithful thing. One action beats ten spirals (James 1:22). Save this reset for later. Make it your reflex.
